en.body: Cambridge Hospital participated as a Gold Sponsor of the inaugural EHS International Critical Care, Organ Donation and Transplant Conference in Dubai. The event brought specialists together to explore developments in critical care, transplantation and patient safety, supporting collaboration across complex care pathways.
